environment: synthetic Odoo, single host, no hosted inference in load
mix: every fourth task is quote prepare/approve/execute/readback; other tasks are sourced customer reads
hosted_canary: one bounded existing OpenAI quotation integration case, separate from load
notes: Small samples; p99 uses nearest rank and is not a production tail guarantee.
Synchronous HTTP execution ack occurs after dispatch/readback; queue wait is measured separately.
No async callback endpoint exists; delayed/lost downstream response and late worker completion cover the applicable recovery paths.
Local alert delivery means durable spool plus explicit receiver acknowledgement; no email/Slack or human paging claim.
